sections.title: How updates are signed
sections.body: Every release is signed with one stable release certificate. Because the certificate stays the same, a new version installs over the old one in place and your data is kept.

sections.title: One-time migration for debug-signed installs
steps: Open Settings, Backup & restore, and download the backup CSV.
Open Settings, Backup & restore, choose the backup CSV and restore it. Your bonds, payments and goals come back.

sections.title: New and changed in v1.0.9
items: Component upgrade across every page: new design tokens, real icons, single top bar with the page name, bottom tabs on mobile, one help entry (#262)
Alerts: the bell is always visible with a 9+ badge; the alert list opens on tap and closes on tap outside or Escape (#262)
Inputs: 48px fields with visible borders, labels above, real-example placeholders, rupee and percent markers inside fields (#262)
Buttons: two sizes, three styles, filled red only on the final confirm; deleting asks through one in-app dialog (#262)
Rating chips with colour bands; status chips single-sourced; all text at 12px or larger; weights limited to 400/600 (#262)
ISIN lookup reports through one thin line under the field - never red, nothing below moves (#262)
Wording sweep across pages and server messages; four known bugs fixed: empty quantity start, empty rupee span, privacy mode hid percentages, alert list opened on hover only (#262)
Android: the back button now closes any open popup or dialog before leaving the page (#262)

sections.title: Does this update need the backup dance?
sections.body: No. v1.0.8 and later install directly over each other with your data intact. The migration steps above apply only to debug-signed installs from before v1.0.8.

rules: No wording may present update data loss as routine or expected. Data loss is never an accepted part of an update; the migration flow above is the only path that moves data between differently signed installs.
